description: This file defines the TestTypeImpl class and related functions for managing test suites, test cases, and test fixtures in Playwright testing framework. It includes methods for creating, configuring, and organizing tests and suites, as well as handling test steps and extensions.

classes.name: TestTypeImpl
classes.description: Class managing test fixtures, test creation, suite organization, and test configuration in Playwright.

methods.name: _currentSuite
methods.description: Retrieves the current test suite based on location, throws error if called in invalid context.

methods.name: _createTest
methods.description: Creates a new test case with specified type, location, title, and function or details.

methods.name: _describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite or nested suite with specific type, location, title, and body.

methods.name: _hook
methods.description: Adds a hook (beforeEach, afterEach, beforeAll, afterAll) to the current suite.

methods.name: _configure
methods.description: Configures the current suite with mode, retries, and timeout options.

methods.name: _modifier
methods.description: Applies modifiers like skip, fixme, fail, slow to tests or suites.

methods.name: _setTimeout
methods.description: Sets timeout for the current suite or test.

methods.name: _use
methods.description: Applies fixtures to the current suite.

methods.name: _step
methods.description: Defines a test step, supporting async execution and timeout.

methods.name: _extend
methods.description: Extends the current test with additional fixtures.
